overviewParagraphs: Tan Son Nhat Golf Course holds a unique position in global golf — it is a massive 36-hole complex located in a densely populated urban setting, just five minutes from the centre of Ho Chi Minh City. Adjacent to the international airport, it is frequently the first or last round of the trip for discerning golfers transiting through Saigon.

Designed by Nelson & Haworth, the two layouts offer different character and challenges, both making inventive use of their constrained urban setting. Water features, strategic bunkering, and mature tree lines create a surprisingly authentic golf experience despite the city skyline visible in all directions.

Tan Son Nhat is the most accessible course in southern Vietnam for the convenience-focused golfer. A round here before catching an evening connection flight makes for one of the most memorable pre-departure experiences in Asian golf.

curatorBriefHtml: Tan Son Nhat Golf Course is a premier Par 71 / 72 (two courses) championship layout in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, crafted by Nelson & Haworth (2015) and stretching to 7,081 Yards (Blue Tees) across a championship layout environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its central city proximity & night golf lights (Play until midnight minutes from airport) and fast true greens & strategic water hazards (Manicured city fairways).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, Tan Son Nhat Golf Course (Resort & Visitor Access via AGS) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Vietnam dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its high-volume caddie professionalism (Polished and punctual), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Ho Chi Minh City golf tour by AGS, Tan Son Nhat Golf Course provides a distinct architectural test by Nelson & Haworth that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.
